newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end up, players optimistic on GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end up, players optimistic on GDP growth.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange continued the trend of recent days to close up Tuesday as players were optimistic on the economy's growth prospects after latest figures showed healthy signs, brokers said.
They added the market would likely rise again Wednesday, although a small technical correction loomed for later in the week.
Tuesday, the General Index .IGRA rose 1.18 percent to 1,488.4 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL climbed 0.95 percent to 2,108.8 points.

Benchmark Telefnica del Per led the market up, climbing 1.36 percent to 5.22 soles on strong volume of 1.8 million shares. Cement company Cementos Lima gained the most among blue chips, closing up 5.13 percent at 4.10 soles on volume of 287,00 shares.
"There is a rumor in the market again among local investors that it (Cementos Lima) could form a joint venture with a Mexican cement company," one broker, who asked not to be named said.
In a total of 1,820 trades, volume was estimated at 25.6 million soles ($9.9 million), brokers said.
